Name: Raccoon Shop Rare Hats
Author: BerryBea
Description:
The raccoons have begun making hats from the flowers, leaves, and mushrooms of the forest and they'll share them with you...if you have enough seeds to spare! (You do need to follow the 1.6 quest line to help the raccoons and unlock their shop in order to start seeing these hats.)

[b]Daisy[/b] costs 5 sunflower seeds and unlocks after feeding the raccoons two times.

[b]Laurel Wreath Crown[/b] costs 50 sunflower seeds and unlocks after feeding the raccoons six times.

[b]Mushroom Cap[/b] costs 50 sunflower seeds and unlocks after feeding the raccoons seven times.

[b]Living Hat[/b] costs 100 sunflower seeds and unlocks after feeding the raccoons eight times.

They cost sunflower seeds in honor of the IRL raccoons that have been raiding my bird feeders and stealing all of the sunflower seeds.

[b]Compatibility
[/b]This mod only adds a few items to a vanilla shop, so it should be compatible with other mods.
